headline: Momentum builds, younger brands accelerate

highlights: Its Q2FY27 performance builds on the momentum seen in Q1, with revenue/volume growth of 35.9%/31.3% YoY.
Mamaearth sustained its high-teens growth, while younger brands grew over 45%.
Importantly, younger brands, excluding TDC, also delivered 40%+ growth, highlighting the emergence of additional growth engines.
Notably, over 80% of ME’s growth delta came from existing outlets.
valuation: Together, these levers keep the company on track to deliver on its FY31 targets.
Valuation and risks We raise our EPS estimates for FY27/28 by ~6/7 (%) to reflect higher revenue growth and better EBITDA margin.
We reiterate BUY, with a DCF-based revised target price of INR 750 (INR 700 earlier).
watch: General Trade (GT) and Modern Trade (MT) both delivered 40%+ growth, while e-commerce grew 20%+, with HSD to DD share in some of the key categories.
